tone: Direct, confident, value-driven — speak to owner operators like a peer who knows the pain points

v1_the_money.ssml: Owner operators are grossing three to six thousand dollars a week with us right now. <break time="500ms"/>Not after probation. <break time="300ms"/>Not after three months. <break time="300ms"/>Week one. <break time="500ms"/>At GSM Transport, you run local Monday through Friday, <break time="200ms"/>weekends if you want them, <break time="200ms"/>and you're home every night. <break time="400ms"/>IFTA, tolls, and company chassis are on us. <break time="300ms"/>You just drive and collect. <break time="500ms"/>If that sounds like what you've been looking for, <break time="200ms"/>we're hiring right now. <break time="400ms"/>Click below and apply now. <break time="300ms"/>The money is real.

v2_home_daily.ssml: When's the last time you had dinner with your family on a Tuesday night? <break time="500ms"/>If you have to think about it, <break time="300ms"/>you're running for the wrong carrier. <break time="500ms"/>At GSM Transport, you run local Monday through Friday, <break time="200ms"/>home every single night, <break time="200ms"/>weekends are your choice. <break time="400ms"/>Thirty-five hundred to six thousand a week <break time="200ms"/>without sacrificing your life at home. <break time="400ms"/>You don't have to choose between the money and your family anymore. <break time="500ms"/>Click below and apply today. <break time="300ms"/>Come home every night.

v3_deduction_scam.ssml: Your carrier is charging you for things that should be free. <break time="500ms"/>By the time you settle, <break time="200ms"/>half your money is gone to tolls, IFTA, and chassis fees. <break time="500ms"/>At GSM Transport, all of that is covered. <break time="300ms"/>You run local, home every night, Monday through Friday. <break time="400ms"/>Three to six thousand a week <break time="200ms"/>and you actually keep it. <break time="500ms"/>If you're done watching your money disappear, <break time="200ms"/>we've got a spot for you. <break time="400ms"/>Click below and apply now. <break time="300ms"/>Your settlement should match your effort.

v4_drop_and_hook.ssml: No tarps. <break time="300ms"/>No lumpers. <break time="300ms"/>No touch freight. <break time="300ms"/>Just container, chassis, and go. <break time="500ms"/>If you're still dealing with live loads, <break time="200ms"/>you're throwing away hours at every stop. <break time="500ms"/>At GSM Transport, it's intermodal drop and hook <break time="200ms"/>within two hundred miles of Chicago. <break time="400ms"/>Monday through Friday, weekends optional, home every night. <break time="400ms"/>Our operators gross thirty-five hundred to six thousand dollars a week <break time="200ms"/>just moving boxes. <break time="500ms"/>If you want a simpler way to make real money, <break time="200ms"/>this is it. <break time="400ms"/>Click below and apply today. <break time="300ms"/>Spend your time driving, not waiting.

v5_500_bonus.ssml: You just passed a DOT inspection with a clean truck. <break time="400ms"/>Where's your bonus? <break time="500ms"/>Your current carrier doesn't notice <break time="200ms"/>and doesn't pay you for it. <break time="500ms"/>At GSM Transport, we hand you five hundred dollars <break time="200ms"/>every time you pass clean on our regional lanes. <break time="400ms"/>That's on top of grossing thirty-five hundred to six thousand dollars a week <break time="200ms"/>with safety bonuses stacked in. <break time="500ms"/>If that sounds like you, <break time="200ms"/>we want you on the team. <break time="400ms"/>Click below and apply now. <break time="300ms"/>Get paid for running a clean truck.

v6_year_round.ssml: January hit and your freight dried up. <break time="400ms"/>Welcome to the slow season. <break time="500ms"/>Seasonal freight will leave you broke three months out of the year. <break time="500ms"/>At GSM Transport, we move intermodal containers across the Midwest year-round <break time="200ms"/>out of every major Chicago rail ramp. <break time="400ms"/>Our operators gross thirty-five hundred to six thousand dollars a week <break time="200ms"/>all year long. <break time="300ms"/>There is no slow season here. <break time="500ms"/>If you're tired of watching the phone go quiet, <break time="200ms"/>we're always moving. <break time="400ms"/>Click below and apply now. <break time="300ms"/>Work every week, get paid every Friday.
